companyFieldUpdates.description: GS Power Partners, legally Green Street Power Partners, LLC, develops, finances, owns and operates distributed-generation commercial, industrial and community-solar assets in the United States. The platform adopted the GS Power Partners brand on December 9, 2024 while retaining its legal identity. CVC DIF holds a majority equity interest through DIF Infrastructure VII; the investment closed in April 2023, while the exact percentage and closing day were not publicly disclosed. Current CVC DIF materials continue to list the company as an infrastructure investment, and no later platform sale, transfer or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026. The company is based in Stamford, Connecticut and reported more than 400 MW across more than 125 projects in August 2026.
